mapper.select: SELECT p.navigation_key FROM place p WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.navigation_key IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.place_id, p.name, f.floor_code AS floor FROM place p JOIN floor f ON f.floor_id = p.floor_id WHERE UPPER(p.name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{brandName}) || '%' ORDER BY p.name FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
